Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Unlock the Power of Observability in AWS!​

Gain Real-time Insights and Take Control of Your AWS Environment

Achieve Unparalleled Visibility and Effortless Optimization for Your AWS Applications with Finther & AWS.

Our suite of observability tools provides deep insights into the health and performance of your AWS setup. These tools continuously monitor key metrics, sending timely alerts if anomalies arise, allowing for rapid intervention and resolution. 

 

By analyzing log data for trends and patterns, we optimize your infrastructure for improved efficiency and cost savings. Additionally, automated reactions to events through observability tools further streamline operations, ensuring smooth and uninterrupted service.

 

This comprehensive approach simplifies AWS management, freeing you to focus on core business priorities. Experience the peace of mind that comes with a well-monitored and optimized AWS environment.

From small startups to global enterprises and public institutions, AWS CloudWatch empowers organizations of all sizes to gain comprehensive visibility, troubleshoot seamlessly, and optimize their AWS environments for peak performance.

 

Understanding the diverse needs of our customers is at the core of our approach. We go beyond basic application monitoring, offering seamless integration of AWS CloudWatch with your applications to unlock the full potential of your AWS investment. This empowers you to gain deeper insights, optimize performance, and maximize the value you derive from your cloud environment.

AWS CloudWatch

Use case for our target customer

Small Business

Scenario

A small e-commerce startup aims to deliver a seamless shopping experience while ensuring reliability and performance.

 

Challenge

Limited resources and staff pose challenges in monitoring cloud infrastructure and identifying performance issues.

 

Solution

Leveraging AWS observability solutions, such as Amazon CloudWatch to gain real-time insights, customize dashboards, set alarms, and optimize resource utilization.

 

Impact

Achieves significant improvements in operational efficiency and performance, enhancing reliability and scalability of the e-commerce platform, driving customer satisfaction and business growth.

Large Enterprise

Scenario

A multinational corporation with a complex IT infrastructure needs to monitor and manage its vast and dynamic cloud environment.

 

Challenge

Operating critical applications and services across multiple regions requires a centralized observability solution.

 

Solution

Utilizing AWS observability solutions, such as Amazon CloudWatch, and AWS CloudTrail, to gain comprehensive visibility, leverage advanced analytics and automation, and ensure optimal scalability and reliability across global operations.

 

Impact

Streamlines operations, reduces overhead, enhances scalability, optimizes performance, mitigates risks, and ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, driving operational excellence and business agility.

Government Sector

Scenario

Government agencies must deliver critical services, protect sensitive data, and adhere to strict security and compliance requirements.

 

Challenge

Operating in highly regulated environments requires robust observability for monitoring, securing, and ensuring compliance.

 

Solution

Leveraging AWS observability solutions, such as AWS CloudTrail and AWS Security Hub, to gain comprehensive visibility, monitor security events, analyze logs, and automate compliance checks to safeguard critical assets and protect citizen data.

 

Impact

Strengthens cybersecurity defenses, mitigates risks, ensures compliance with regulatory mandates, enhances transparency, accountability, and trust in operations, ultimately safeguarding critical assets and protecting citizen data.

Our Service Delivery Practice (Process)

  • 1. Introduction Session
  • 2. Solution Proposal
  • 3. Solution Proposal Evaluation
  • 4. Project / PoC Deployment
  • 5. Handover

The introduction session is the first step in our customer engagement process, where our teams meets with the client to understand their requirements, challenges, and objectives, align expectations, establish connection, and begin a cooperative relationship.

After the introduction session, our teams crafts a tailored solution proposal outlining the recommended approach, technologies, methodologies, timelines, and budgetary considerations to meet the client’s needs and goals, providing a clear roadmap and understanding of the solution’s potential impact and benefits.

Solution Proposal Evaluation:

Upon presentation of the solution proposal, the client thoroughly evaluates its suitability and alignment with their organizational objectives through a comprehensive review process, assessing technical feasibility, scalability, cost-effectiveness, and strategic alignment. Our team is available to address any inquiries or concerns, ensuring transparency and clarity throughout the evaluation.

Upon approval of the solution proposal, our teams begins the deployment phase or Proof of Concept (PoC), implementing the solution within a controlled environment, conducting thorough testing and quality assurance. We maintain open communication with the client, offering regular updates and progress reports for transparency and accountability.

Upon successful project or PoC completion, our department conducts a formal handover to the client, including solution ownership transfer, comprehensive documentation, and tailored training/support. Our aim is to empower the client with the necessary knowledge and resources for effective solution management, while committing to ongoing support for a mutually beneficial partnership.

Unleash CloudWatch's Potential

Experience the power of AWS CloudWatch and unleash the full potential of your AWS environment. Elevate your monitoring game with CloudWatch today!

Monitor Everything

From EC2 instances to Lambda functions, CloudWatch provides real-time monitoring for all your AWS resources, giving you a unified view of your entire infrastructure.

Actionable Insights

Detect and diagnose issues before they impact your customers with CloudWatch's customizable alarms and rich metrics. Stay proactive with automated responses to common problems, ensuring seamless operation and exceptional user experiences.

Scale with Confidence

As your business grows, CloudWatch scales with you. It seamlessly handles massive volumes of data, ensuring that you always have the insights you need to make informed decisions and drive business success.

Optimize Performance

Identify performance bottlenecks and optimize resource utilization with CloudWatch's advanced analytics and visualization tools. Make data-driven decisions to streamline operations, reduce costs, and maximize ROI.

Secure and Reliable

Rest easy knowing that your data is protected by AWS's world-class security measures. CloudWatch offers robust encryption, access controls, and compliance certifications, ensuring the highest levels of data integrity and regulatory compliance.

Insights & Alerting

Detection engine finds and generates insights that help teams prioritize issues by impact and importance.

  • DDOS DETECTION & NETWORK SECURITY

  • DIGITAL EXPERIENCE MONITORING

  • CLOUD OBSERVABILITY

  • Mitigate DDoS Attack – fine-tune rules to catch early signs of traffic spikes or anomalous traffic behavior.
  • Protect Against Botnets – analyze botnet traffic characteristics and trends over time and alert on significant changes in threat traffic volume, routes and source geo-locations.
  • Identified Compromised Hosts – detect hosts using unexpected servers or services by using historical data to see points of ingress and lateral movement of threats.
  • Test to/from Anywhere – to emulate the performance of applications for the users.
  • The Path View – shows the multiple paths taken by your traffic, highlighting nodes and links with high latency and loss.
  • The State of the Internet – monitor the state of SaaS applications, in and between public clouds and DNS service providers.
  • Visualize Cloud – see what you’ve been missing for flow data, health metrics, and VPC connectivity.
  • Optimize Cloud Services – determine the best deployment model and most efficient traffic patterns for your services.
  • Migrate Apps Confidently – baseline application performance and understand security, capacity and geo-location impact before moving between clouds.

// FAQS

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Manage Performance Services?
Performance management is a corporate management tool that helps managers monitor and evaluates employees’ work. Performance management’s goal is to create an environment where people can perform to the best of their abilities and produce the highest-quality work most efficiently and effectively.
What is Network Performance Monitoring?
Network Performance Monitoring is the process of visualizing, monitoring, and optimizing, troubleshooting, and reporting on the health and availability of your network as experienced by your users. Network performance Monitoring (NPM) tools can utilize a different type of telemetry including:
  •  Device metrics, such as SNMP, WMI, CLI, API, logs, and synthetic tests.
  • Network flow data, such as NetFlow, jFlow, IPFIX, etc.
  • Packet data. Everything you do on a network requires packets; it carries data across the network.
What is Application Performance Monitoring?
The process of measuring important software performance parameters using monitoring software and telemetry data is known as application performance monitoring (APM). APM is used by professionals to guarantee system uptime, enhance user experiences, and optimize service performance and response times.

Common use cases for monitoring include commercial applications, the internet, and mobile apps. However, in today’s digitally interconnected world, monitoring use cases now include the services, hosts, processes, logs, networks, and end users who utilize these applications, such as clients and staff of a business.
What is Observability?
Observability provides deep visibility into a modern distributed system for faster, automated problem identification and resolution.

Observability is the extent to which you can understand the internal state or condition of a complex system based only on knowledge of its external outputs. The more observable a system, the more quickly and accurately you can navigate from an identified performance problem to its root cause, without additional testing or coding.
What is the End User Experience Monitoring?
End User Experience Monitoring (EUEM) analyzes the performance of a user’s end-to-end workflow across multiple devices, networks, clouds, and applications with the goal of improving business productivity.
What is Infrastructure Monitoring?
Infrastructure Monitoring is used to collect health and performance data from servers, virtual machines, containers, databases, and other back end components in a tech stack. Engineers can use an infrastructure monitoring tool to visualize, analyse, and alert on metrics and understand whether a backend issue is impacting users. In this article, we’ll explain how infrastructure monitoring works, its primary use cases, challenges to keep in mind, and tools to help you get started.
What is Actionable insight?
Actionable insight is a conclusion drawn from data that can be turned directly into an action or a response. The data informing the insight can be structured or unstructured, quantitative, or qualitative. While actionable insight provides the impetus for action, people, or processes are needed to execute the actions.

Actionable insight arises from one or more people analyzing raw data. Actionable insight can be derived from big data when large amounts of structured and unstructured data are involved.
What is the Performance Management Maturity Model?
Performance Evaluation serves as a health check on operations and individuals’ work. The organizational maturity notion signifies the progress of an organization in terms of developing its people, processes, technology, and capability by implementing quality practices. Organizations aiming to achieve the highest maturity levels in performance need to take care of the intricacies involved in deploying a Performance Management system and the relationships it has with the other key organizational activities.

Performance Management processes in organizations can be assessed using maturity levels, by measuring the implementation of Performance Management tools, analysing the availability of internal Performance Management processes in place, and assessing the structures, procedures, and interactions utilized to direct Performance Management systems.
